target.title: fix: keep tests off the real keychain to stop login-keychain prompts
target.body:
## Summary

Kills the recurring macOS login-keychain password prompt for "CodexBar Cache" at its root: test runs were writing real keychain items.

The login keychain contained six leaked items labeled "CodexBar Cache" with services like `com.steipete.codexbar.cache.tests.<UUID>`, created by test runs on 2026-01-16. Items minted by the test runner carry test-runner ACLs, so the app later hits them (or their siblings) without being a trusted app and macOS shows the password prompt. Those items have been deleted from the affected machine; this PR makes the leak impossible to recreate.

## Root cause

`KeychainCacheStore`'s implicit test store only engaged while the keychain access gate was disabled. Any test wrapping cache traffic in `KeychainAccessGate.withTaskOverrideForTesting(false)` (done by many Claude OAuth suites to exercise gate-enabled logic) fell through to real `SecItemAdd`/`SecItemCopyMatching` calls against the login keychain.

## Changes

- `KeychainCacheStore`: cache dispatch now always stays on the in-memory test store while running under tests, regardless of gate overrides (opt out via `CODEXBAR_ALLOW_TEST_KEYCHAIN_ACCESS=1`). Also no longer DEBUG-gated.
- `KeychainAccessGate`: the under-test forced lockdown is no longer compiled out of release builds, covering `swift test -c release` runs.
- `AlibabaCodingPlanCookieImporter`: the Safe Storage password read now honors the access gate and applies `KeychainNoUIQuery` — previously it was a raw `SecItemCopyMatching` with `kSecReturnData` that a disabled-gate preflight (`.notFound`) still fell through to.
- Claude `security` CLI reader: argument construction now refuses to target the real login keychain under tests (previously only the `CODEXBAR_DISABLE_KEYCHAIN_ACCESS=1` env var forced the isolated-keychain requirement, not the under-test process detection).
- Regression tests for the cache-store dispatch and the CLI-reader argument guard.
- `MenuCardCostComparisonTests`: fixed a pre-existing timezone dependency from #1816 — `updatedAt` at midnight UTC put the window anchor on the previous local day west of UTC; test data is now stable for UTC-12 through UTC+14.

## Testing

- Full suite: 5,120 tests / 529 suites. All keychain-related suites green; remaining parallel-run timing flakes pass serially.
- Cost comparison test verified under `TZ=America/Los_Angeles`, `TZ=UTC`, and `TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati`.
- Login keychain verified free of `codexbar.cache.tests` debris after cleanup.
